form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Ms. Butler introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Community Development Banking and Financial Institutions Act of 1994 to include in technical assistance provided by the Community Development Financial Institutions Fund resources for non-English speaking individuals, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Community Finance Language Inclusion Act of 2024.

section.header: Inclusion of resources for non-English speaking individuals in technical assistance provided by the Community Development Financial Institutions Fund
section.text: Section 108(c)(1) of the Community Development Banking and Financial Institutions Act of 1994 (12 U.S.C. 4707(c)(1)) is amended—

paragraph.text: by striking training and inserting the training;
by striking and development and inserting , the development; and
by striking products. and inserting products, and the provision of outreach and resources for non-English speaking individuals or individuals with limited English proficiency..
